da-non-sequitur.evidence: [sidecar review 2026-11-15, issue #8030] `lean.ref` `QOU.JetProlongation` is a `structure`, not a theorem: the inherited (Δ', ε', S'), the Frobenius relation `jet_frobenius` and the embedding are all fields; nothing asserts that J¹(A) carries them. The only theorem, `jet_prolongation_preserves_observability`, transfers `Subsingleton` along a caller-supplied injective map (`h_inj` is the whole content). The QOU claim and τ' = τ∘(−⊗Ω¹) are unencoded. S↔P: the vanishing step is a non-sequitur: from Ad(A) ↪ Ad(J¹(A)) (a subobject) it concludes that invariants of the larger object project injectively to the smaller one, which a subobject inclusion does not give; "uniqueness of A' follows from irreducibility of A'" is circular in A'; the Frobenius–Hopf inheritance is delegated to lem:jet-prolongation-categorical-jet, which fails above

md:5-9 still says J¹(A) := (A⊗A)/I² 'inherits the Frobenius--Hopf data (Δ', ε', S')' citing lem:jet-prolongation-categorical-jet, which no longer states any inheritance (retracted 2026-11-21; open per the 2026-11-22 note). md:13-14: non-degeneracy of a form on J¹(A) does not follow from A being a direct summand (the form on the I/I² complement is neither defined nor shown non-degenerate). Pre-existing class, carried through the edit.
